title: amberToCopper
description: Data contract for the Amber to Copper handoff.

issueId.description: Original GitLab bug id. Traceability: bug -> test case -> script.

steps.description: Ordered logical steps. Each item is one atomic step.

actualResult.description: Observed behavior. Helps decide edge cases.

severity.description: Single source of truth. Copper derives target suite (smoke/regression) from this.

testType.description: Drives assertion strategy (expect success vs expect error).

gherkin.description: Given-When-Then. Maps ~1:1 to Playwright: given->setup, when->action, then->assertion.

testData.description: Optional. Non-sensitive inputs only. Real credentials live in .env, never here.
